title: A valid relationship adds no blank row: VALUES, ALL and the table reference agree
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "Table", COUNTROWS ( Product ), "Values", COUNTROWS ( VALUES ( Product ) ), "All", COUNTROWS ( ALL ( Product ) ), "Colors", COUNTROWS ( VALUES ( Product[Color] ) ) )

source.quote: If the relationship is valid, that is if all the rows in Sales contain a value that matches one row in Product, then the two functions behave identically
source.supports: with a valid relationship there is no blank row and the functions agree

derivation: Every Sales[ProductKey] (1, 2, 2, 3, 1, 3, 1) is in Product, so there is no blank row. Product has 4 rows; its colors are Red, Red, Blue, Green: 3 distinct. Scooter (4) having no sales does not create a blank row.
